text: なかまだけで　わかりあえる　なきごえで　おたがいの　いちを　たしかめながら　えものをおいつめる。

structure.jp: なかまだけで　わかりあえる　なきごえで
structure.en: with cries that only their pack can understand among themselves

structure.jp: おたがいの　いちを　たしかめながら

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら on a verb means doing that at the same time as the main action. たしかめながら = 'while checking'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: なかまだけで　わかりあえる　なきごえ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right in front of a thing describes that thing. なかまだけで　わかりあえる　なきごえ = 'cries that only the pack can understand among themselves'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows what is used to do the action. なきごえで = 'by means of cries'.
